Title: Remote work and team productivity in distributed software teams
Abstract: We study how remote work changes team productivity in distributed software teams using survey data.

Title: Hybrid schedules and collaboration quality
Abstract: Hybrid work schedules are compared with office work on collaboration quality and team productivity.

Authors: Garcia, Mia; Olsen, Per; Chen, Li
Title: Telework adoption after the pandemic: a review
Abstract: A narrative review of telework adoption and its effect on team outcomes and productivity.

Title: Video meetings, fatigue and output of knowledge workers
Abstract: Video meeting load is related to fatigue and lower output among remote knowledge workers.

Title: Asynchronous communication norms in remote teams
Abstract: Norms for asynchronous communication predict productivity in fully remote teams.

Title: Office redesign and employee wellbeing
Abstract: Office redesign improves wellbeing but has no measured effect on collaboration.
